thag3.13:1.1: Suṇātha ñātayo sabbe yāvant' ettha samāgatā, dhammaṃ vo desayissāmi; dukkhā jāti punappunaṃ. || ||
thag3.13:2.1: ārabhatha nikkhamatha yañjatha buddhasāsane dhunātha Maccuno senaṃ naḷāgāraṃ va kuñjaro. || ||
thag3.13:3.1: yo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye appamatto vihessati, pahāya jātisaṃsāraṃ dukkhass' antaṃ karissatīti. || || Abhibhūtathero.
